title: Integration harness and regression suite for weight-only INT8 quant profiles (GPTQ / AWQ)
creator: Elena Park
description:
Background: We need a repeatable integration and regression harness that validates INT8 weight-only quantization profiles generated by both GPTQ and AWQ toolchains across our serving fleet. Past outages and subtle quality regressions have come from mismatches between profile assumptions, kernel selection, and cross-hardware numerics. This ticket scopes the end-to-end harness, canary workflow, and automated regression checks that will gate CI and canary deploys.

Goals:
- Provide an automated pipeline that executes profile generation, applies profile artifacts to serving variants, and runs golden-answer and statistical accuracy checks.
- Surface regressions early with signalized thresholds (answer-diff, BLEU/ROUGE proxies, log-perplexity deltas) and rollback automation for canaries.
- Validate behavior across representative hardware (A10072, H100, heterogeneous mixed GPU nodes) and sequence-length distributions.

Scope:
- Ingest GPTQ and AWQ profile artifacts produced by model-onboarding jobs.
- Attach profiles to model shard variants and exercise the runtime kernel selection and quantized execution paths.
- Run regression suites: fast smoke, medium synthetic, and long-run golden-answer comparison.
- Produce telemetry: unit-level token deltas, end-to-end latency histogram, and cost-per-token estimate.

Out of scope for this ticket: integrating FP8 flows (separate follow-up), production rollout automation for Dedicated customers (pilot only).
acceptance_criteria: CI job that consumes a GPTQ profile and an AWQ profile and runs a smoke harness with pass/fail exit codes
Canary pipeline that deploys profile-attached model variant to a dedicated canary pool and monitors metric thresholds for 24h
Regression job produces a daily artifact with golden-answer diffs and a numeric summary (mean absolute token-delta, % samples exceeding threshold)
Playbook document (Confluence) describing rollback triggers and manual mitigation steps
Telemetry events emitted with schema documented and validated against the observability team
test_plan: Smoke: 200 short prompts across 4 seed variants comparing unquantized vs GPTQ-weight-only vs AWQ-weight-only outputs
Synthetic stress: batch of 10k prompts mimicking production seq-len histogram, measure latency and memory amplification under continuous load
Golden-run: 1k curated evaluation prompts with human-reviewed expected outputs; compute answer-diff and rank regressions
Chaos: apply kernel-swap and simulate degraded GPU precision to trigger fallback and validate fallback correctness
Nightly sweep: run a broader cross-model drift detector and store artifacts for offline analysis
steps: 1) Build adapter in quant-profile-registry to accept GPTQ/AWQ artifact formats (PR: github.com/redwood/quant-registry/pull/241)
2) Extend canary-orchestrator to accept profile hash and pin model-variant to profile (feature branch: canary/profiles)
3) Add smoke/regression jobs to CI (circleci / k8s runners) with resource labels for target GPU types
4) Hook telemetry exporter to console metrics namespace and add dashboard panel templates
5) Run cross-hardware validation and collect golden-answer diffs into S3 bucket for nightly aggregation
6) Iterate on thresholds after initial run; push rollback rules into canary orchestration if signals are noisy
